events.title: North American Eclipse
events.description: A total solar eclipse crosses parts of Mexico, the United States and Canada.

events.title: Paris Olympics
events.description: The Summer Olympics open in Paris, France.

events.description: Sheikh Hasina leaves office amid widespread protests in Bangladesh.

events.description: Syrian rebels enter Damascus and President Bashar al-Assad flees the country.

events.description: Donald Trump is inaugurated for a second term as US president.

events.title: Myanmar Earthquake
events.description: A powerful earthquake strikes Myanmar and affects neighboring Thailand.

events.description: Youth-led protests begin in Nepal following restrictions on social media platforms.
